video_title: Will LeBron & 76ers Be Good Right Away?

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: predicting games played for LeBron James and Joel Embiid
quotes.excerpt: how many games are LeBron James and Joel Embiid going to play and play together?

text_blocks.speaker: Vince Carter
text_blocks.text: My only question is how many games are LeBron James and Joel Embiid going to play and play together?

text_blocks.speaker: Tim Bontemps
text_blocks.text: Embiid probably 40-ish based on his recent history, and then LeBron. He played 57 the last two years, and LeBron played 51, maybe 60 last year. I'm sorry, he played 51, he played 51 a couple years ago. Whatever it was.

text_blocks.speaker: Vince Carter
text_blocks.text: Maxey and Edgecombe are going to play, and Jaylen Brown is going to play. Short of some type of injury, they are all going to play. Embiid and LeBron, I think you look at those two guys, at least for me, I look at Philly like I look at the Knicks where they probably, using Windy's thing about those guys being healthy, you just want to be healthy by April 15th.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: why the 76ers need time to develop chemistry
quotes.excerpt: it is going to take some time, some minutes, some weeks, months for them to figure out fit
quotes.quote: It is going to take some time, some minutes, some weeks, months for them to figure out fit and chemistry because they have five guys in the starting lineup, four who are proven all-stars, all-NBA players, and then VJ Edgecombe is obviously an ascending star. So they have five guys in the starting lineup who want the ball. The rest of the group is built to play 85, 95 miles per hour, and Joel Embiid's highest speed limit is 25 miles per hour. That is Embiid speed.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: predicting 48 wins for the 76ers this season
quotes.excerpt: I think they can be an excellent team and very formidable and win 48 games.
quotes.quote: I think they can be an excellent team and very formidable and win 48 games. I think 48 wins in the Eastern Conference is going to be a great season this year. Because you don't know about Embiid, you don't know about health and all the other stuff. I think it is just safe to go under. I think probably going under on the Sixers has been a profitable position, frankly. And not only that, LeBron's teams when he has changed teams, they have tended to get off to slower starts.
